data.command: Can you tell me about your firewall rules?

data.text:
Firewall rules. Well, I've got a pretty solid setup here. I'm running Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS, kernel 5.15.0-91, and I'm using the Uncomplicated Firewall (UFW) to manage my firewall rules.

Here's what I've got configured:

```bash
# UFW status
Status: active
Logging: on (low)
Default: deny (incoming), allow (outgoing)
New profiles: skip

To                         Action      From
--                         ------      ----
22/tcp                     ALLOW       192.168.1.0/24
80/tcp                     ALLOW       Anywhere
443/tcp                   ALLOW       192.168.1.0/24
80/tcp (v6)               ALLOW       Anywhere (v6)
443/tcp (v6)             ALLOW       192.168.1.0/24 (v6)
```

I've got SSH (port 22) open only for the local network (192.168.1.0/24) for management purposes. HTTP and HTTPS (ports 80 and 443) are open for the entire world, except for the initial request, which is proxied through nginx/1.24.0
